# Toastpad

> > Toastpad is a Ukrainian recipe sharing platform featuring traditional and modern cooking from contributors Katerina and Andriy Kovalchuk.

The site showcases diverse Ukrainian cuisine alongside international dishes, with a strong focus on healthy cooking, vegan alternatives, and Mediterranean-inspired recipes. Content includes both detailed recipes and cooking technique guides.

## Key Topics

- ukrainian-cuisine
- vegan-recipe
- healthy-cooking
- main-dish
- dairy-free
- Mediterranean cuisine
- seafood
- shrimp
- festive dishes
- desserts
- plov variations
- Turkish cuisine
- Italian cuisine
- cooking techniques
- plant-based alternatives

## Main Dishes & Savory Recipes

- [Турецький біюрек з м'ясною начинкою](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/25798-turetskiy-biyurek-z-myasnoyu-nachinkoyu): Turkish meat-filled biyurek pastry recipe by Andriy Kovalchuk
- [Плов з булгуром та куркою](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26111-plov-z-bulgurom-ta-kurkoyu): Healthy bulgur & chicken plov recipe by Andriy Kovalchuk
- [Овочева запіканка з рибою та креветками](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26443-ovocheva-zapikanka-z-riboyu-ta-krevetkami): Vegetable casserole with fish & shrimp by Andriy Kovalchuk
- [Смачні млинці з різними начинками](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/25653-smachni-mlintsi-z-riznimi-nachinkami): Ukrainian pancakes with various fillings by Andriy Kovalchuk
- [Риба по-турецьки в мультиварці](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26275-riba-po-turetski-v-multivartsi): Turkish-style fish in multicooker recipe by Katerina
- [Курячі стегенця в медово-горіховому соусі](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26648-kuryachi-stegentsya-v-medovo-gorikhovomu-sousi): Chicken drumsticks in honey-nut sauce festive recipe by Katerina
- [Італійський рибний суп з помідорами](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/27001-italiyskiy-ribniy-sup-z-pomidorami): Italian Mediterranean fish soup with tomatoes by Andriy Kovalchuk

## Salads & Light Dishes

- [Салат з куркою та ананасами](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26740-salat-z-kurkoyu-ta-ananasami): Chicken & pineapple salad recipe for holidays by Katerina
- [Салат з креветками, помідорами чері та чечевицею](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26746-salat-z-krevetkami-pomidorami-cheri-ta-chechevitseyu): Shrimp, cherry tomato & lentil salad recipe by Katerina

## Vegan & Plant-Based Recipes

- [Пісний пиріг з гарбуза](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26822-pisniy-pirig-z-garbuza): Vegan lenten pumpkin pie recipe by Andriy Kovalchuk
- [Домашня сметана з кешью](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/27077-domashnya-smetana-z-keshyu): Vegan cashew sour cream recipe by Andriy Kovalchuk on Toastpad
- [Кокосовий сир на основі кокосової стружки](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26720-kokosoviy-sir-na-osnovi-kokosovoyi-struzhki): Vegan coconut cheese from coconut flakes recipe by Katerina
- [Фрикадельки з бобових](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/25964-frikadelki-z-bobovikh): Vegetarian bean fritters recipe by Andriy Kovalchuk

## Desserts & Sweet Treats

- [Солодкий плов з гарбузом та родзинками, запечений в яблуках](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/27097-solodkiy-plov-z-garbuzom-ta-rodzinkami-zapecheniy-v-yablukakh): Sweet plov recipe with pumpkin & raisins baked in apples by Katerina
- [Цитрусовий десерт з апельсинів](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/27101-tsitrusoviy-desert-z-apelsiniv): Quick refreshing citrus orange dessert recipe by Katerina

## Breads & Beverages

- [Солений хліб з пряними травами](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26840-soleniy-khlib-z-pryanimi-travami): Savory herb bread with oregano & basil by Andriy Kovalchuk
- [Кавовий напій з маслом](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/27053-kavoviy-napiy-z-maslom): Bulletproof butter coffee energy drink recipe by Katerina
- [Енергетичний чай з імбиру та лимона](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26348-energetichniy-chay-z-imbiru-ta-limona): Energizing ginger-lemon tea recipe by Katerina

## Cooking Guides & Techniques

- [Шоколад на водяній бані](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/25665-shokolad-na-vodyaniy-bani): Double boiler chocolate melting technique guide by Andriy Kovalchuk
- [Смачні морепродукти на вашій кухні](https://toastpad.com/ua/recipe/26228-smachni-moreprodukti-na-vashiy-kukhni): Seafood cooking guide with tips for preparing fish & shellfish
